title: Anthropic's Collapse: Is Claude 3 Officially Dead? #shorts
description: Is Anthropic finished? A mass exodus erupts as users rage over new model limits and inconsistencies. Opus's past glory fades, with open-source models poised to take over. #Anthropic #AIModels #TechNews #OpenSource
transcript: Is Anthropic finished? A mass exodus erupts as users rage over new model limits and inconsistencies. Opus's past glory fades, with open-source models poised to take over. #Anthropic #AIModels #TechNews #OpenSource

top_comments.author: @JordanJordi-d4d
top_comments.text: Been watching this unfold. Several open-weight models already match frontier performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Users who got silently downgraded just leave without announcing it.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Frontier isn’t a monopoly anymore. If you quietly make the product worse, users quietly leave. Which open model are you seeing people jump to most?

top_comments.author: @CircuitSage-d5e
top_comments.text: Ignore the 'mass exodus' hype. Opus hallucinated too. The real squeeze is inference economics. Nail cost-to-quality or the exodus becomes real.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That’s the core issue. Buzz about people jumping ship distracts from the real constraint: making strong models affordable to run at volume. Every provider hallucinates sometimes, so price and output quality will decide who stays. Where do you see the balance landing first — cheaper inference or better reliability?
